proof_explanation: The buggy implementation violated the Boolean negation law by always returning false, regardless of the input. The corrected implementation applies the negation operator directly: `!value`. This satisfies the postcondition `ensures result == !value` for all boolean inputs—when value is false, !value evaluates to true; when value is true, !value evaluates to false. The repair preserves the module structure, the @id annotations, and the law strength while establishing total Boolean negation.
